title: Meta expands Instagram’s AI age-guessing tech globally
slides: Meta now guesses your age on Instagram worldwide — who's safe?
It scans profile signals, not just your birthday
Adults get flagged as teens more often than expected
Under-18 accounts get locked into stricter private defaults
Check your account's age label — it may already be wrong
thread_text:
1. Who's Actually Safe?

Meta now guesses your age on Instagram worldwide. The system scans profile signals, not just your birthday — so your account may already be labeled.

2. It Scans Your Profile

Likes, follows, comments, even the accounts you interact with feed the guess. No birthdate needed — the algorithm builds a shadow age.

3. Adults Flagged As Teens

False positives hit grown users more than expected. That means unexpected privacy changes — and a label you never chose.

4. Teens Get Locked Down

Under-18 accounts are forced into stricter private defaults. Fewer recommendations, limited messaging — protections you can't opt out of.

5. Check Your Age Label

Open Instagram settings and find the age label. If it's wrong, request a review now — before the defaults reshape your account.

instagram.caption:
Instagram may already have guessed your age — and it won't ask your birthday to do it.

Meta rolled the system out worldwide: it reads likes, follows and comments to build a "shadow age" for your profile. 🧐

Adults get flagged as teens more often than you'd expect, and under-18 accounts are pushed into stricter private defaults you can't opt out of. 🔒

If you post for a living, a wrong label can quietly cut your reach and messaging limits overnight.

Open Instagram settings, find your age label, and request a review if it's off. Have you checked yours yet? 👀
